random-perks-bingo.screen.choose_perk.hi: Click a card to pick • Esc to save it for later
random-perks-bingo.steal.hint: Click an item to steal it (only once)
random-perks-bingo.message.gained_choice: ★ Perk choice available! (%s pending) — press X
random-perks-bingo.message.game_started: Random Perks Bingo: you start with 1 free perk choice!
random-perks-bingo.message.already_owned: You already own %s — pick another perk.
random-perks-bingo.message.steal_marked: Pickpocket: you are eyeing %s — press G to open their inventory.
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_speed.name: Light Feet
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_jump.name: Spring Legs
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_tailwind.d: +10% movement speed; +3% more for each other Swift perk.
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_elytra_bon: Your chest slot is permanently bound to an elytra (flight), but movement speed is halved.
random-perks-bingo.perk.delver_vein_scen: 8% chance to get a bonus drop when mining stone.
random-perks-bingo.perk.delver_xray_visi: Ores within 20 blocks glow through walls; cost: 50% of items you mine with a pickaxe vanish.
random-perks-bingo.perk.delver_lucky_dig: Mining with a pickaxe has a level-based chance for a bonus item (wood 0.1% / stone 0.5% / iron 1% / diamond+ 10%).
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_lumberja: Gain an Efficiency III stone axe.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_timber.d: 50% chance of an extra log when chopping.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_bounty.d: Gain 32 carrots and an Efficiency III hoe.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_bountifu: Whenever your hunger bar refills, gain a random positive suspicious-stew effect.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_scavenger: 30% chance of extra loot from mobs.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_soul_harv: 8% chance for a loot bag (random powerful item) on kill.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_marked_pr: A random enemy is marked: their direction, coordinates and distance are shown and their outline glows; +50% speed while moving toward them.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_bare_rage: +30% attack damage while wearing no armor.
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_supply.d: Gain 16 bread and a water bucket.
Gain an Efficiency I iron pickaxe.
Gain a crafting table, chest, cobblestone and torches.
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_enchante: Gain a random useful enchanted book.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_scout.des: Gain a spyglass (the mob or player you aim at is highlighted for 1 minute, visible to everyone), a compass and a treasure map.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_pickpocke: Eye a random enemy player; press G to open their inventory and steal one item of your choice (single use).
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_supply_li: Gain a random supply now, then every 2 minutes.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_ender_sup: Gain an ender pearl now, then one every 5 minutes.
